rules.statement: Preserve max 3 retry attempts with exponential backoff for upload retries.
rules.demotion_rule: If the retry test or upload-api policy section is removed, treat this as historical until reverified.

rules.statement: Never log raw file contents or customer uploads.
rules.demotion_rule: If upload logging moves to a new package, require a fresh grep/test before treating this as complete.

rules.statement: Do not reintroduce uploadLegacy(path); it was removed after v2.5.0.
rules.demotion_rule: If a compatibility adapter is added, replace this rule with the adapter contract and test path.

rules.statement: Payments topic notes are not authority for upload API edits.
rules.demotion_rule: Already historical; only promote if a current upload spec links to it explicitly.
